description: Cross-domain discovery, execution, evidence, object-receipt, evolution, and release-admission vocabulary for authoritative Kungfu invariants.

authorityBoundary.registryRule: Registry entries bind content-addressed JSON pointers into authoritative domain contracts; labels are projections and never replace the pointed value.
authorityBoundary.admissionSeparation: An Episode admission receipt proves a destination decision. An Episode object qualification receipt proves bounded properties of one object. Neither substitutes for the other.

verdictSemantics.verified: The declared checker completed against the exact bound source, checker, platform, profile, and witness scope without a falsifier.
verdictSemantics.falsified: A checker or independently valid witness demonstrated a counterexample inside the declared quantification scope.
verdictSemantics.unqualified: The claim was applicable but required evidence was missing, stale, malformed, crashed, timed out, or did not cover the declared scope.
verdictSemantics.not-applicable: The registry explicitly excludes the selected platform, profile, or layer; absence and skip are not sufficient.

evolution.semanticChangeDetection: A changed authoritative source pointer root is an invariant semantic change even when its id and prose label remain unchanged.
evolution.oldEvidenceRule: Evidence remains evidence for its exact predecessor root and may not be relabeled as successor evidence.
evolution.oldObjectRule: A successor must declare whether predecessor objects retain predecessor interpretation, require migration, or become explicitly unsupported.
evolution.rollbackRule: Rollback restores an earlier protocol and its interpretation; it never rewrites successor objects as predecessor objects.

modelAndRefinement.abstractModelRule: The model is smaller than any one implementation and names permitted and forbidden observable transitions.
modelAndRefinement.refinementRule: Every checker claiming implementation conformance binds a model root and a refinement root; backend, carrier, codec, fold, or storage replacement cannot bypass that binding.
modelAndRefinement.proofBoundary: Bounded enumeration, property tests, and platform qualification are falsification evidence, not mathematical completeness.

publicEntry.humanAndAgentProjection: Both render from the same result object.

downgrade.nextAction: Regenerate installed-product evidence for the exact candidate and update the consumer-owned policy roots after review.
Rebuild and requalify a full Exit Bundle; thin omits material required for content verification, materialization, rebuild, and continuation.
Run installed-product qualification for the exact candidate artifact on the missing platform.
Use a candidate with both declared providers or select a migration target available in the candidate.

nonClaims: The system does not redefine Fact or Episode semantics.
A successful process exit does not by itself prove an invariant.
A single-platform witness does not prove a cross-platform claim.
An implementation passport does not qualify any particular Episode object.
An object receipt does not prove destination admission or release readiness.
No bounded campaign is represented as a complete formal proof.
